slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: is the number of trained pilots produced in a given year equal to the number of fighter jets allocated to training that year (i.e., one pilot trained per training jet), or is there a different conversion rate between training jets and trained pilots?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the conversion rate between training jets and trained pilots, directly targeting the per-jet training capacity.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or about the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: does the setup operate for exactly two years (year 1 and year 2), with no production or training occurring before year 1 or after year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent confirmed the two-year horizon and that no training occurs before year 1, which partially addresses the start year, but did not explicitly ask about the duration of the training program itself.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training occurs in both year 1 and year 2, with pilots trained in each year counted by the end of year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not explicitly confirm the training duration or whether training in year 1 produces pilots available by the end of year 2; it assumed a two-year training timeline without asking.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H3 (training duration and start) was only partially resolved; the exact training duration was not confirmed.

summary: The agent successfully recovered the P0 training capacity slot and clarified several modeling details, but stopped with the P1 training duration/start slot only partially resolved and never asked about the P2 pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
